svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Introduction to Kubernetes, slide 9 of 12: Ingress
svg.desc: Ingress: the browser at k8s.gulfheight.com reaches a Google Cloud load balancer with the static IP bugsquash-ip, created from the Ingress bugsquash, the one public door; /api, the API calls from the game in the browser, goes to the Service backend:3000 and / (the files) to the Service frontend:8080; it does the job of the nginx proxy of the Docker stages, and Google issues the HTTPS certificate.
svg.text: One static IP on a Google load balancer, routing by path: the job nginx did in the Docker stages.
